notes: This narrow trace maps only the joined-federate switch update and public getter checks to IEEE 1516.1-2025 MOM clause 11.4.1 and the pinned IEEE 1516.2-2025 standard MIM. It does not claim that service reports are delivered to subscribers or written to a file.

requirements.statement: The standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction permits a joined federate to send individual declared parameters; HLAsendServiceReportsToFile sets that joined federate's destination switch to the provided value and selects whether service-report interactions are sent to subscribers or logged to a file.
